## Top 3 Priorities This Week

### 1. 🔴 INVESTIGATE: Why is click→signup conversion near zero?

1,126 emails sent. 22 clicked. ~0 signed up from those clicks. The `/organizer-solution` landing page from the demand-gen playbook is **not deployed** — clicks likely land on the generic homepage or a dead end. This is the most likely conversion killer.

**Action:** Deploy the `/organizer-solution` landing page (HTML template is ready per `landing-page-html-template.html`). Route outreach email CTA to this URL. Track conversions by source.

**Owner:** Patrick + findasale-dev (30-min deployment per DEMAND_GEN_SUMMARY.md)

### 2. 🔴 ACTIVATE: Onboard Abundant Treasures + Lopez Studio before they churn

Two real organizers signed up in the last 10 days. Both are on free tier. Neither has a published sale visible in DB. If they can't get a sale live in the first week, they will ghost.

**Action:** findasale-customer-champion should draft welcome + activation emails for both. Check if either has started adding items or created a sale. Manually reach out if needed (Patrick email or in-app).

**Signal:** Lopez Studio has a Stripe customer record (attempted Connect onboarding) — they are actively trying to use the platform, not just browsing.

### 3. 🟡 EXECUTE: Demand Gen Playbook (April 2026 — still not started)

The DEMAND_GEN_SUMMARY.md was written in April. It identified the before/after video as the #1 demand gen asset. As of today (June 19) — **2 months later — the video has not been filmed**, no community posts appear to have been made, and the landing page is not live.

The content pipeline has generated weekly LinkedIn/social post copy (most recently June 18) but there's no evidence it's been posted.

**Actions:**
- Film the 2:30 before/after demo video (the playbook's Week 1 item — 2 months overdue)
- Post the June 18 LinkedIn/social content drafted in `content-pipeline/content-2026-06-18.md`
- Deploy `/organizer-solution` landing page

## Concern Flag: Organizer Growth Stalled

**0 real organizers signed up between April 13 and June 9 — a 57-day gap.** Abundant Treasures on June 9 and Lopez Studio today (June 19) are the first signs of life. At 2 real signups in ~10 days (with 429 emails sent), conversion is improving but still very slow.

The demand-gen playbook predicted 3-5 organic signups in Month 1 via community + video channels. Those channels have not launched. The current email-only approach is generating opens but not conversions, likely because there is no compelling landing destination for clicks.

**Recommendation:** Do not increase email volume further until the landing page is live and click→signup conversion is measurable. More emails to a broken funnel just increases unsubscribes.
